I am currently a visiting researcher at Chalmers University in Gothenburg. 

I hold a PhD in Economic History from Lund University. My PhD research focused on the transition to a bioeconomy in the Swedish forest sector.
My research interests are sustainability transitions, forests and forest policy, technological change and political economy.
